name: fit sparse penalized regression and select the penalty by multiple criteria
definition: train a lasso-style model while choosing the regularization strength via cross-validation and via information criteria (including a corrected AIC), and train a ridge-style variant, recording the chosen penalty and degrees of freedom.
failure_mode: missing variant labels, identical penalties, or all-identical scores fail several assertions.

name: implement a compiled c program that parses a weight file
definition: Write a native binary that reads a JSON-formatted model-weight file and converts its contents into the in-memory tensors needed for inference.
failure_mode: Parse or type errors produce wrong weights and wrong outputs.

name: iterate every mask row in a metadata csv and note prompts
definition: Read a pandas CSV where each row has a cell rectangle (corner coords) and coordinate lists, build a prompt per row and run segmentation for every row, not just a sample.
failure_mode: Skipped rows or only subset produce masks that do not match/all rows.

name: load a molecular catalog from a local JSON and filter names case-insensitively
definition: Read a molecule JSON file at a runtime path and return matching molecules whose name matches case-insensitively, honoring a result limit.
failure_mode: Hard-coded data, wrong case handling, or no result bounds.
